title: Iwasawa mu = 0 Conjecture for Cyclotomic Z_p-Extensions
exact_target: In every cyclotomic prime-adic tower of number fields, is the fastest Iwasawa growth term in the prime part of the class numbers absent?

sources.citation: Adithya Chakravarthy, The Iwasawa mu-invariants of Elliptic Curves over Q, arXiv:2408.07826v2 (2024), Introduction, Conjecture 1.1 and following paragraph.
